gaps.sentence: Everything happened ___ such short notice that we panicked.
The tickets sold out ___ a matter of hours.
gaps.explanation: 'in a matter of hours' = within only a few hours.

gaps.sentence: The castle dates ___ to the fourteenth century.
Everything was packed ready in ___ of the movers' arrival.
I did it ___ my own initiative — nobody asked me.
gaps.explanation: 'of one's own initiative' = without being asked.

gaps.sentence: ___ first glance, the deal looks generous.
gaps.explanation: 'At first glance' = when first looked at quickly.

gaps.sentence: The proposal was rejected ___ a single vote.
gaps.explanation: 'by a single vote / by two goals' — the margin takes 'by'.

gaps.sentence: The bus was so crowded that we travelled ___ discomfort.
